{{Quote|My son, Prince Vork, must marry a princess. One of wealth, breeding, and wealth. Gorphs, bring in the canidates.|Queen Slugga|audio=Slugga-MySonMustMarryAPrincess.flac|<ref name="Princess Latara" />}}
'''Gorphs''' were [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Amphibian/Legends|amphibians]] native to the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]] known for their long tongues. Gorphs lived in a [[Gorphs' grotto|grotto]]. By [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Slugga]] abducted [[Prince/Legends|princesses]] from other tribes on Endor to [[Marriage/Legends|marry]] her son Prince [[Vork (Gorph)|Vork]], but was foiled by a group of [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]].

==Biology and appearance==
{{Quote|Ok Kneesa, you and Teebo distract them while I swing down and pluck Latara out from under their warty little noses.|Wicket W. Warrick|audio=Wicket-WartyNoses.flac|<ref name="Princess Latara" />}}
[[Sentience/Legends|Sentient]]<ref name="Princess Latara" /> [[Frog/Legends|frog]]-like [[Amphibian/Legends|amphibians]] from the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]], the Gorphs were known for their long [[Color/Legends|pink]] [[Tongue/Legends|tongues]] which they used to catch their [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]].<ref name="CE Gorph" /> They had green skin, lacked [[Hair/Legends|hair]], had few teeth, and hopped around to move. Their eyes were dark green, surrounded by yellow sclera.<ref name="Princess Latara" /> Gorphs were about 2 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] in height,<ref name="Height" /> had three [[Limb/Legends|fingers]] and toes, tails, and huge chins with three green dots. When hopping, they made a squishy noise.<ref name="Princess Latara" />

==Society and culture==
{{Quote|Once you marry my son, our two tribes will unite with me as ruler.|Queen Slugga to Latara|audio=Slugga-OurTwoTribesWillUnite.flac|<ref name="Princess Latara" />}}
Living in a [[Gorphs' grotto|grotto]], Gorph society was tribal, and led by a [[Queen/Legends|queen]]. Sitting atop a throne, if the queen disapproved of someone, they were cast into a dark hole in her audience chamber known as [[Pit (Gorph's grotto)|the Pit]]. Most Gorphs wore orange [[Suit/Legends|suits]] and [[Glove/Legends|gloves]] atop green [[shirt]]s, however Queen [[Slugga]] wore a green and yellow robe and [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Vork (Gorph)|Vork]] wore a blue shirt. Most Gorphs held [[Spear/Legends|spears]], however members of the royal family did not.<ref name="Princess Latara" />

==History==
{{Quote|Princess Latara? Oh boy, an Ewok princess for Queen Slugga.|A Gorph chatting with another Gorph|audio=Gorphs-OhBoy.flac|<ref name="Princess Latara" />}}
[[File:Gorphsgrottoinside.png|thumb|right|250px|Queen Slugga conversing with Gorphs in her audience chamber]]
By [[3 ABY]],<ref name="Date note">{{EwoksDate|appearance of the Gorphs|[[Princess Latara]]}}</ref> Queen Slugga was in power, ruling from the grotto. She looked for [[Prince/Legends|princesses]] from their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of Endor to marry [[Gender/Legends|her]] [[Reproduction/Legends|son]], Prince Vork, in an attempt to unite different tribes, with herself as ruler.<ref name="CEL">{{InsiderCite|27|A Star Wars CELibration|A ''Star Wars'' CELibration}}</ref> Two sets of Gorphs returned first with the [[Mudgub princess|princess]] of the [[Mudgub]] tribe, and then the [[Titterbug princess|princess]] of the [[Titterbug]] tribe. Though Prince Vork was attracted to both, the queen disapproved and ordered the princesses to be cast into the pit. The queen then turned to the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]], seeing an opportunity to unite the two [[Bright Tree Village tribe|tribes]]. She sent out Gorphs to capture the Ewok princess. Two Gorphs then found a group of Ewoks. The Gorphs believed that [[Latara/Legends|Latara]] was a princess and would please Queen Slugga. When the two Gorphs returned with Latara, who was pretending to be a princess for the day, Latara stated that she wasn't the real princess. This angered Slugga who used her tongue to hang Latara over the pit. Before being dropped in however, Latara lied, telling Slugga that she actually was the real princess. Slugga commenced the [[Marriage/Legends|wedding]], in spite of Latara's continued protestations.<ref name="Princess Latara" />

After finding a piece of Latara's hood, her Ewok friend [[Wicket Wystri Warrick/Legends|Wicket]] noticed Gorph tracks heading to the grotto. Wicket, the real Ewok princess [[Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka/Legends|Kneesaa]], and [[Teebo/Legends|Teebo]] went to rescue her, arriving just as the wedding began. Hearing noises, two Gorphs went out to investigate, causing the Ewoks to hide. After finding nothing, the Gorphs headed back to the wedding. The Ewoks overlooked the wedding and began planning on how to save Latara, when they again got caught by guards, but Wicket tackled a Gorph while Kneesa stepped on the foot of the Gorph holding her. This caused the Gorphs to jump in pain, allowing the Ewoks to escape. Heading to the queen's audience chamber, the group rescued Latara, running down a hall to escape. Slugga, Vork, and two Gorphs began chase of the Ewoks. After the Ewoks failed to climb a slippery ramp, the Gorphs were getting ever so closer when Wicket took Kneesaa's [[Crown/Legends|crown]] and threw it, sending Slugga, Vork, and two other Gorphs into a spiral. The spiral of Gorphs rolled into Slugga's audience chamber, eventually sending the Gorphs into their own pit.<ref name="Princess Latara" />

==Behind the scenes==
Gorphs first appeared in "[[Princess Latara]],"<ref name="Princess Latara" /> the fourth episode in the [[Ewoks: Season Two|second season]] of the animated television series [[Ewoks (television series)|''Ewoks'']]. The episode was written by [[Paul Dini]] and premiered on [[September 20]], [[1986]].<ref name="CEL" />

''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' entry for Gorphs decapitalizes the species as "gorph," something it does with non-sentient species only.<ref name="CSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref> "Princess Latara" however, shows the species to be sentient.<ref name="Princess Latara" /> This article takes the Ewoks episode as precedence.
